review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review; independent reviewer findings are evidence, not approval of this design)
review.decision: Address four confirmed exact-Q review findings before merge
review.notes: Review 53dab0f produced deterministic pending retarget, HQ missing receipt/ID, HQ late failure and stale Detail screen counterexamples. New cases live in new files to preserve prior design chronology. Preserve exact target, draft/menu/approval checks, stable retry, unknown no-replay and old accepted receipt compatibility. Isolated fixtures only; do not replay real queues, resume sessions, deploy or release. Existing full-core/cloud results apply only to old Q; new revision gets appropriate fresh gates and bounded independent delta review.

cases.description: Retry stays bound to its original complete native target
cases.setup: Real private Prepare/ClaimNative/FinishNative spool, fake native RPC, synthetic homes only
cases.action: Retry pending within and beyond 15 seconds while changing session, instance, binding, home, PID or server epoch; repeat unchanged and accepted old targets
cases.expected: No pending request is reused or claimed for a changed target; bridge rechecks prepared identity before RPC mutation. An already accepted historical receipt remains a no-op; unchanged pending preserves its ID and unknown outcomes never replay.

cases.description: HQ shares stable send identity and actual ingress receipt with ordinary conversation
cases.setup: Real HQConsoleView and Composer with fake transport/timers and shared transcript echo helper
cases.action: Send queued/accepted/submitted/legacy, timeout then explicit retry after 21 seconds, and a repeated prompt already in history
cases.expected: HQ uses sendResult and a stable ID reused on explicit retry; exposes actual receipt, not endless Sending; old identical history cannot clear new echo. Failed reason retained, no automatic retry or real input.

cases.description: HQ late results and retries cannot cross a newer attempt or target identity
cases.setup: Real HQConsoleView with deferred requests and mutable client/pane/session/home identity
cases.action: Overlap first/second success/refusal/timeout, later key then text receipt; change target or unmount before response; confirm transcript; use both legacy onSend key and production onSendKey callback
cases.expected: Only corresponding current echo receives receipt; old failure cannot erase newer success. Old results/retry cannot move to a rotated HQ/client/pane; newer control-key screen remains. Confirmation retires only the matching new turn and accepted echo is not resurrected.

cases.description: Late Detail text receipt settles delivery without reverting a newer terminal snapshot
cases.setup: Real DetailView, deferred text send and later control-key success with distinct screen/cursor/columns
cases.action: Resolve old text receipt after newer key snapshot through both Composer onSend legacy keys and the production onSendKey callback
cases.expected: The matching text echo becomes accepted, but old snapshot neither invalidates current reads nor replaces newer text, geometry or cursor. No replay and target guards stay in place.

cases.description: Existing HQ attachment and matter journeys use the new structured send callback without weakening their assertions
cases.setup: Existing real HQ/Composer synthetic attachment, draft and matter workflows
cases.action: Keep existing interactions, mock sendResult rather than removed boolean send path, require a generated send ID in exact target/body assertions
cases.expected: Picker/upload ordering, cancellation, retry, no auto-send, draft/server/session isolation and matter state assertions all remain. Only callback shape changes; new receipt semantics are covered separately by MSD007/008.
